title: Zeroth hypercohomology on a small ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Write $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ for the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $D(\mathcal O)$ for its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The global sections functor is $\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O,-)$ with values in abelian groups. Define the functor $H^0(\mathcal C,-):D(\mathcal O)\to\operatorname{Ab}$ as $H^0\circ R\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)$, where $R\Gamma$ is the unbounded right derived functor computed on K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Thus for any K-injective complex $\mathcal J^\bullet$ representing $K$, $H^0(\mathcal C,K)$ is canonically isomorphic to $H^0(\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal J^\bullet))$, independently of the representative. Such representatives exist by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist].
